title: How to Accidentally Break Business Central (for Fun)
summary: Analysis Mode's Pivot functionality can freeze or crash a Business Central session when handling large datasets with many columns and rows, as demonstrated by attempting to sort AppSource partner offerings by count.
key_points: Pivot mode in Analysis Mode becomes unresponsive when dealing with thousands of columns combined with hundreds of rows
Switching a page with many data points to Pivot mode and adding numerous fields to Column Labels can strain system performance
The Microsoft AppSource apps page does not support direct Export to Excel, making Analysis Mode a seeming alternative
This demonstrates a practical performance limitation when using Analysis Mode for complex data pivoting

quotes.text: Best case: A frozen session. Worst case: RIP Business Central. Maybe even RIP Browser.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the severity of the performance issue, ranging from session freezing to complete browser failure
